cmd.configureCliTool: Configure Coding CLI (Codex, Claude Code, Cline…)
cfg.baseUrl: OmniRoute base URL (OpenAI-compatible). Point it at your local install or any remote OmniRoute instance. Read from your user settings (or the remote machine's); a value in a workspace's settings is ignored.
cfg.statusBar: Show the OmniRoute connection indicator in the status bar.
cfg.statusBarUsage: Show how much of the key's daily limit is left next to the connection status.
cfg.healthCheckIntervalSeconds: How often the status bar probes the OmniRoute server (seconds).
cfg.maxOutputTokens: Maximum output tokens reserved per response.
cfg.defaultContextLength: Context length assumed for models whose catalog entry does not declare one.
cfg.modelFilter: Optional case-insensitive substring or regex to limit which models are listed in the picker (e.g. "glm|kimi"). Empty lists everything.
cfg.dashboardOpen.external: Open the dashboard in your default web browser.
cfg.dashboardOpen.editor: Open the dashboard in a VS Code editor tab (Simple Browser). Requires an OmniRoute version that allows embedding.
cfg.defaultReasoningEffort: Default reasoning effort for models that support extended thinking. Leave unset to let each model decide; a value picked in the chat UI always wins.
cfg.defaultReasoningEffort.xhigh: Extra high — downshifted for models without it
cfg.defaultReasoningEffort.max: Max — the top tier. OmniRoute downshifts it for models that do not offer it.
cfg.cliPath: Path to the OmniRoute CLI, used by the "Configure Coding CLI" command.
cfg.exposeToAgentsWindow: Experimental: also list OmniRoute models in the Copilot Agents window model picker. Requires the VS Code setting chat.agentHost.byokModels.enabled and an agent host restart; uses a proposed VS Code API that may change.
cfg.sendProjectName: Send the name of the open workspace to OmniRoute with every chat request, so usage can be grouped by project. Off by default.
walkthrough.title: Get started with OmniRoute
walkthrough.description: Put the models of your OmniRoute gateway in the Copilot Chat model picker.
walkthrough.run.title: Run OmniRoute
walkthrough.run.description:
OmniRoute is the gateway this extension talks to. Install it and leave it running. By default it answers at http://localhost:20128.
[Install OmniRoute](command:omnicopilot.installOmniRoute)
[Check the connection](command:omnicopilot.checkConnection)
walkthrough.connect.title: Connect
walkthrough.connect.description:
Open the connection panel. If OmniRoute runs on this machine with its default settings, there is nothing to fill in. For a server somewhere else, enter its URL and, if it asks for one, an API key.
[Open the connection panel](command:omnicopilot.manage)
walkthrough.pickModel.title: Pick your models
walkthrough.pickModel.description:
Open Manage Models, choose OmniRoute and tick the models you want in the chat model picker.
[Manage models](command:workbench.action.chat.manage)
walkthrough.utility.title: Use OmniRoute for titles, commit messages and inline chat
walkthrough.utility.description:
Chat titles, commit messages and inline chat use their own model settings. Point them at an OmniRoute model to run those on your gateway too.
[Open the settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22chat.utility%22%5D)
